issues.title: Missing Weekend Orders
issues.description: The order data contains no Saturday or Sunday orders. The data generator only produced weekday (Mon-Fri) orders, omitting the expected Saturday (0.30 multiplier) and Sunday (0.15 multiplier) volume.
issues.expected: ~430 Saturday orders and ~215 Sunday orders across 24 months
issues.impact: Day-of-week charts will show no weekend activity. Monday is over-represented at 2.14x multiplier (expected 1.35x). ~8.7% of expected order volume is absent.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run order generation with weekend date selection enabled, or redistribute ~600 orders from weekdays to weekends.

issues.title: LSH Order Frequency Below Target
issues.description: Locksmith Shop (LSH) customers average 2.6 orders/month, well below the target range of 8-15 orders/month specified in CLAUDE.md.
issues.expected: 8-15 orders per LSH customer per month
issues.actual: 2.6 orders per LSH customer per month (max: 9)
issues.impact: Per-customer order frequency views may appear unrealistic for locksmith accounts.
issues.suggested_fix: This is constrained by the total order volume target (~7,900 orders / 24 months / 68 LSH customers = ~4.8 max possible). Would need either more total orders or fewer LSH customers to reach 8-15x frequency.

validation_script_fix.description: Fixed timezone bug: changed getDay() to getUTCDay() and getMonth()/getFullYear() to getUTCMonth()/getUTCFullYear(). Dates in CSV are parsed as UTC midnight by new Date('YYYY-MM-DD'), but getDay() returns local timezone day, causing a 1-day shift in EST/EDT.
